name: Gremlin
description: Gremlins are mischievous fairy-like creatures of 20th-century aviation folklore, blamed by Royal Air Force pilots from the 1920s onward for unexplained mechanical faults in aircraft.

aliases.name: Fifinella
aliases.meaning: female gremlin in Roald Dahl's 1943 book

origin: Originated in the British Royal Air Force in the 1920s and spread through Allied air forces during World War II; subsequently a global pop-culture motif.
